title: Tangential divergence of a radial-type field: div_S(a(·)(· − y)) = n·a + Da[p_S(z − y)]
statement: Let N, n ∈ ℕ, a : ℝ^N → ℝ differentiable at z ∈ ℝ^N, y ∈ ℝ^N and S ∈ G(N,n). Then the tangential divergence (Varifold.tangentialDivergence, the trace of S.1 times the Jacobian matrix) of the field w ↦ a(w)(w − y) at z with respect to S equals n·a(z) + Da(z)[p_S(z − y)], where p_S = Grassmannian.project S.
lean_statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ) (a : Euclidean N → ℝ) (y z : Euclidean N) (S : Grassmannian N n), DifferentiableAt ℝ a z → Varifold.tangentialDivergence (fun w ↦ a w • (w - y)) z S = n * a z + fderiv ℝ a z (Grassmannian.project S (z - y))
